summary: Fixed REV-3 (focus hand-off when a tool closes). CommandPalette now records the control that had focus when it mounts and gives focus back when it unmounts (Escape or choose), skipping the page body, disconnected elements and elements inside a hidden panel; when nothing sensible is left it lands on the footer's always-visible 'Toggle sidebar' button. App now records the opener when the git drawer opens (openGitTab) and closeGitTab restores it, falling back to the git tools chip, so closing the drawer no longer leaves focus on its hidden Close button; hideGitTab (openApp, openConsole, resetLayout) clears the record. Added one focus-restore test per path. No other behaviour changed. Lint, the full 432-test suite and the production build pass, with the palette still in its own on-demand chunk.
